topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, now. Isn’t it a curious twist of the heavens that my friend from the online wells of words lives in the same stone walls as me? The world’s a narrow path, it seems, more so than the one that winds through the fields. I reckon we’ll meet at the market soon, swapping tales of cyberspace and the scent of fresh hay. Perhaps the saints have their own plans, guiding us together over the same earth we’ve always known. It’s a fine day, with a good sun and a clear sky, as if the earth itself is smiling at the chance meeting of two friends who’ve journeyed through the same fields of silence.
